page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.medium is an entry-level virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs, derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled at 2 threads per core, and features a dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.n1.medium demonstrates entry-level performance characteristics. Its stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 1108.59 falls into the bottom 25%, while its multi-core score of 2194.17 is in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 159.5 GB/sec and a large block uncached read speed of 16.3 GB/sec. Similarly, the Geekbench single-core score of 959.0 and multi-core score of 1698.0 place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively, reflecting limited processing throughput for complex tasks.

The instance's hardware profile offers a low-cost entry point for workloads that do not require high computational density or massive memory footprints. Tradeoffs include poor performance in database operations with a PassMark database score of 570.41 and static web serving throughput of 1.9 GB/sec. However, it maintains a steady throughput of 2.87 million operations per second for Redis SET operations. This server type is best suited for lightweight utility workloads, basic development environments, simple text processing, or low-traffic application testing where resource demands are minimal.
